app.name: Avenza
common.simulatedLabel: This app is connected to a simulated bank. No real money moves.
boot.tapHint: Touch the screen once, anywhere, so Avenza can speak. You only do this once.
boot.failedBody: Check your connection and try again. Your money has not moved.
language.title: Choose your language
consent.title: Before we start
consent.p1: Avenza listens to your voice while the app is open, so it can understand your request.
consent.p2: Your voice is processed by speech and language providers working for Avenza: {providers}.
consent.p3: We keep only what is needed for the audit record of your transfers.
consent.p4: Your voice never approves a payment. Only your fingerprint does.
consent.p5: You can withdraw your consent at any time in Settings.
consent.notNowBody: Avenza cannot work without listening to your voice. You can come back and agree whenever you are ready.
consent.error: We could not save your consent. Check your connection and try again.
finger.title: Register your fingerprint
finger.body: Avenza uses your phone's fingerprint to approve every transfer. Your fingerprint never leaves your phone.
finger.cancelled: Registration was cancelled. Try again when you are ready.
finger.noAuthenticator: This phone needs a screen lock or fingerprint set up. Open your phone settings, add a fingerprint, then come back.
finger.error: Something went wrong while registering. Try again.
status.expired: Time ran out. No money moved.
hint.listening: Try: Send 5,000 naira to Aisha Bello
hint.noSpeech: I'm still here. Tell me who to send money to.
hint.hearing: Keep talking. I'll stop when you pause.
hint.unclear: I didn't catch that. Say yes, no, or repeat.
hint.sending: Please wait. This takes a moment.
hint.pending: Your bank has not confirmed yet. Please wait.
voice.latency: End of speech to first sound: {ms} ms
error.title: Something needs attention
error.connection_lost: I lost the connection. Your money has not moved.
error.offline: You're offline. I'll keep trying. Your money has not moved.
error.mic_denied: I need the microphone to hear you.
error.provider_down: I can't understand speech right now. Your money has not moved.
error.timeout: I didn't get an answer in time. Your money has not moved.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Your money has not moved.
mic.title: Allow the microphone
mic.body: Avenza needs the microphone to hear you. In Chrome on Android:
mic.step1: Tap the lock icon next to the web address.
mic.step3: Choose Allow, then come back and tap Try again.
settings.title: Settings
settings.withdrawBody: Avenza will stop listening and remove everything stored on this phone. You will need to start again to use it.
history.title: History
history.disabled: History is not switched on yet.
scam.title: New recipient, large amount
scam.body: This is the first time you are sending to this person, and the amount is large. Take a moment to check it is right.
duplicate.title: Send again?
lock.title: Transfers are locked
lock.body: Nothing can be sent until you unlock with your fingerprint.
update.available: A new version of Avenza is ready.
dev.title: Developer panel
error.network: I can't reach Avenza. Check your connection and try again.
error.slow: That took too long. Please try again.
error.server: Avenza had a problem. Please try again shortly.
error.deviceExpired: This phone is no longer registered. Please set up again.
finger.nameHint: Avenza uses this to greet you. Up to 200 characters.
warn.duplicate: You sent a similar payment recently
warn.new_recipient_large: New recipient and a large amount
warn.name_mismatch: The name differs from your bank's record
settings.name: Name
settings.lockNowBody: Nothing can be sent until you unlock with your fingerprint.
history.noReceipt: A receipt is available once the transfer has been sent to the bank.
home.intro: I'm Avenza, your voice banking assistant. How can I help you today?
home.sendHint: Just tell me. For example, say: send five thousand naira to GTBank, account zero one two three nine eight seven zero zero one.
nav.label: Main
verify.title: Verify your identity
verify.body: Place your finger on the sensor to authorise this transfer.
success.title: Transaction successful
onboard.sayAgree: If you agree, say: I agree.
onboard.fingerSay: Place your finger on the sensor when your phone asks.
onboard.askName: What name should I call you? Say your name.
onboard.nameHeard: Thanks, {name}. Now place your finger on the sensor to register.
onboard.sayName: Say your name, or type it.
lang.betaLabel: {name} is in beta: Avenza's words in this language have not been checked by a native speaker yet.
onboard.askLanguage: Welcome to Avenza. Which language would you like to use? English, Hausa, Igbo or Yoruba?
onboard.sayLanguage: Say the language you want, or tap it.
boot.tapLabel: Start Avenza. Touch anywhere on the screen once so Avenza can speak to you.
onboard.tapToFinger: Touch anywhere on the screen, then place your finger on the sensor.
onboard.tapToFingerLabel: Register your fingerprint. Touch anywhere on the screen, then place your finger on the sensor.
onboard.noName: I did not catch your name. Please say it again.
ob.title: Set up Avenza
ob.greeting: Hello, and welcome to Avenza, your voice bank. I'll get you set up in under a minute.
ob.askNameAgain: Sorry, I didn't catch that. What's your name?
ob.askLanguage: Nice to meet you, {name}. Which language should I speak: English, Hausa, Igbo or Yoruba?
ob.askLanguageAgain: Please say English, Hausa, Igbo or Yoruba.
ob.consent: One quick thing. I listen while Avenza is open, and my speech partners process your voice only to understand you. Your voice never moves money: only your fingerprint does. Do you agree?
ob.consentAgain: If you agree, say: I agree.
ob.finger: Last step. Place your finger on the sensor to register it.
ob.done: You're all set, {name}. Welcome to Avenza.
ob.micDenied: I need the microphone to hear you. Allow it in your browser, then say I agree again.
ob.saveFailed: I couldn't save that. Let's try once more.
ob.step.name: Name
